part_5_declarations.description: Part V - Declarations containing declaration statements and authorized signatory details for the shipping bill

declaration_statement.description: Large text area for declaration statement content. This is where the exporter/customs broker declares the accuracy and completeness of the information provided in the shipping bill.
declaration_statement.note: This section typically contains standard legal declarations affirming the truthfulness of the information provided, compliance with export regulations, and acceptance of penalties for false declarations.
